content.summary: Guideline recommendations for diagnosis and management of chronic heart failure (HF), including specific comorbidities (aortic stenosis, diabetes, iron deficiency, sleep apnoea, arthritis, cancer, and amyloidosis), diagnostic testing, and therapies for HFrEF and HFmrEF/HFpEF.

diagnosis: Use BNP/NT-proBNP, 12-lead ECG, transthoracic echocardiography, chest radiography (X-ray).
Routine blood tests: full blood count, urea and electrolytes, thyroid function, fasting glucose and HbA1c, iron studies (TSAT and ferritin).
Cardiac MRI recommended for assessment of myocardial structure/function or tissue characterization when indicated (e.g., infiltrative disease, amyloidosis).
pharmacologic_treatment_HFrEF: ACE inhibitors (or ARNI where indicated), beta-blockers, MRAs, and SGLT2 inhibitors are recommended to reduce HF hospitalization and mortality.
Sacubitril/valsartan (ARNI) recommended as replacement for ACE-I in patients with HFrEF to reduce risk of HF hospitalization and death.
Diuretics for symptomatic relief of congestion.
device_therapy: ICD recommended in selected patients to reduce sudden death risk (specific eligibility criteria apply).
CRT recommended in symptomatic patients with reduced LVEF and prolonged QRS/ LBBB morphology per guideline criteria.

comorbidity_specific.aortic_stenosis: Consider aortic valve intervention (TAVI or SAVR) in patients with HF and severe high-gradient aortic stenosis.
comorbidity_specific.diabetes: SGLT2 inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin, sotagliflozin) recommended in patients with T2DM at risk to reduce HF events and CV death; recommended in patients with T2DM and HFrEF to reduce hospitalizations and CV death.
comorbidity_specific.iron_deficiency: Screen all patients periodically for anaemia and iron deficiency with full blood count, serum ferritin and TSAT; treat iron deficiency as indicated.
comorbidity_specific.sleep_apnoea: Adaptive servo-ventilation not recommended in patients with HFrEF and predominant central sleep apnoea due to increased mortality risk.
comorbidity_specific.arthritis/NSAIDs: NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors are not recommended in patients with HF.
comorbidity_specific.cancer: Patients with cancer at increased CV risk should undergo pre-treatment CV evaluation; involve cardio-oncology expertise as needed.
comorbidity_specific.amyloidosis: Tafamidis is recommended for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CA), including genetic (variant) and wild-type disease, in patients with NYHA class I–II symptoms to reduce symptoms, hospitalizations and mortality.

content.grading_info: Recommendations include class and level indications (A, B, C; I, II, III) throughout the document for strength of recommendation and evidence level.

genes.context: The guideline states: 'Tafamidis is recommended in patients with genetic testing proven ATTR-CA and NYHA class I or II symptoms ...' and separately recommends tafamidis in patients with wtATTR-CA and NYHA class I or II symptoms to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalization and mortality.
